mapper.select: SELECT id, employee_no, name, phone, department_id, position_id, status, hire_date, leave_date FROM employee WHERE employee_no = #{employeeNo} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, employee_no, name, phone, department_id, position_id, status, hire_date, leave_date FROM employee WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee (employee_no, name, phone, department_id, position_id, status, hire_date) VALUES (#{employeeNo}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{departmentId}, #{positionId}, #{status}, #{hireDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE employee SET department_id = COALESCE(#{departmentId}, department_id), position_id = COALESCE(#{positionId}, position_id), status = #{status}, hire_date = COALESCE(#{hireDate}, hire_date), leave_date = #{leaveDate} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT h.id, h.employee_id, h.before_status, h.after_status, h.before_department_id, before_department.name AS before_department_name, h.after_department_id, after_department.name AS after_department_name, h.before_position_id, before_position.name AS before_position_name, h.after_position_id, after_position.name AS after_position_name, h.source_request_id, request.request_no, h.operator_id, COALESCE(operator_employee.name, operator.username) AS operator_name, h.created_at FROM employee_status_history h JOIN employee e ON e.id = h.employee_id LEFT JOIN org_department before_department ON before_department.id = h.before_department_id LEFT JOIN org_department after_department ON after_department.id = h.after_department_id LEFT JOIN org_position before_position ON before_position.id = h.before_position_id LEFT JOIN org_position after_position ON after_position.id = h.after_position_id LEFT JOIN hr_request request ON request.id = h.source_request_id LEFT JOIN sys_user operator ON operator.id = h.operator_id LEFT JOIN employee operator_employee ON operator_employee.id = operator.employee_id WHERE h.employee_id = #{employeeId}
ORDER BY h.created_at DESC, h.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee_status_history h JOIN employee e ON e.id = h.employee_id WHERE h.employee_id = #{employeeId}
